import shutil

def organiziraj(direktorij):

        put = os.path.join(direktorij, f)
        if os.path.isfile(put):
            ext = os.path.splitext(f)[1][1:] or 'ostalo'

            os.makedirs(nova_mapa, exist_ok=True)

import copy

class Editor:
    def __init__(self):
        self.tekst = ''
        self.povijest = []

     def napisi(self, novi_tekst):
         self.povijest.append(copy.deepcopy(self.tekst))
         self.tekst += novi_tekst

     def undo(self):

from backtesting import Backtest, Strategy
from backtesting.lib import crossover
from backtesting.test import SMA, GOOG

class SmaCross(Strategy):
    n1 = 10
    n2 = 20
    def init(self):
        self.sma1 = self.I(SMA, self.data.Close, self.n1)
        self.sma2 = self.I(SMA, self.data.Close, self.n2)
    def next(self):
        if crossover(self.sma1, self.sma2):
            self.buy()
        elif crossover(self.sma2, self.sma1):
